finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry.** [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

Of 380 commits and 127 PRs, only 11 were user-visible. One breaking change, one feature, nine fixes.

- `401` replaces `403` for expired tokens
- webhook deliveries now retry with backoff
- nine bug fixes, spanning duplicate headers, null-cursor pagination crashes, a request-body logging leak, and more

Everything else was deps, refactors, tests, or CI.

Worth a skim before you ship it, in case any wording needs your judgment call on severity.
